ANJALI THAKUR
Microbiology & Agro Lab Analyst | M.Sc. Microbiology
Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India | +91 98XXXXXX21 | anjali.thakur@email.com | linkedin.com/in/anjalithakur
PROFILE SUMMARY
Detail-oriented Microbiology postgraduate with 3 years of hands-on laboratory experience at a Micro Agro Lab,
specializing in soil and crop microbial analysis, sample testing, and quality control. Proficient in culturing techniques,
microscopy, and lab safety protocols, with a strong foundation built through B.Sc. and M.Sc. coursework. Committed to
accurate documentation and supporting agricultural research through reliable lab practices.
WORK EXPERIENCE
Lab Analyst - Microbiology | Micro Agro Lab Aug 2023 - Present
• Conduct microbial analysis of soil, water, and crop samples to assess nutrient content and pathogen presence.
• Perform culturing, staining, and microscopy techniques to identify beneficial and harmful microorganisms.
• Maintain accurate lab records, test logs, and sample chain-of-custody documentation in compliance with lab SOPs.
• Assist in formulating bio-fertilizer and bio-pesticide samples by testing microbial viability and contamination levels.
• Calibrate and maintain lab equipment including autoclaves, incubators, and microscopes.
• Coordinate with the agronomy team to translate lab findings into actionable soil health recommendations for
farmers.
Lab Trainee - Microbiology | Micro Agro Lab Jul 2022 - Jul 2023
• Supported senior analysts with sample preparation, media preparation, and routine microbial testing.
• Learned and applied standard aseptic techniques and lab safety protocols under supervision.
• Assisted in data entry and preliminary analysis of test results for internal reporting.
